details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: lines 143-522 (deleted model_provider_broker_* functions including start, stop, prepare_codex_writer, prepare_codex_readonly, exec_sanitized, exec_unprivileged, grant_read_path, capture_acl, and supporting helpers) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The model-provider broker API was removed while numerous live workflows and scripts still invoke its functions.
  WHY: Broker-routed phases fail with command-not-found before Codex launches, and the credential-isolation boundary is removed.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: Argument parser lines 95-110 (removed --provider-base-url case), validation lines 150-155 (removed URL validation), line 261 (hard-coded base_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1") | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed while callers still pass it, and the provider URL is hard-coded to the public OpenRouter endpoint.
  WHY: Callers fail with an unknown argument, while bypassing the loopback broker would expose the provider key and defeat credential isolation.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: Deleted is_sensitive_target_path (was lines 158-171), removed call in normalize_path (line 249), removed MAX_TARGET_PATHS (was line 155), removed MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES (was line 157), removed path-count bounding at emit_context (lines 559-570) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path-count and path-length bounds were removed from targeted context generation.
  WHY: Issue-derived paths can inline credential-bearing files into model prompts and can generate unbounded filesystem and prompt work.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context (lines 536-716), normalize_path (lines 240-247) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Missing-file, binary-skip, and overflow markers are appended without advancing `used_bytes`.
  WHY: Rendered context can exceed `TARGETED_FILE_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES`; severity was reported as MAJOR by some reviewers and BLOCKER by none, so the highest reported severity is high.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: lines 208-212 (broker startup and preparation removed), line 668 (--sandbox danger-full-access replaces brokered read-only) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose now invokes Codex with `--sandbox danger-full-access` without the model-provider broker or sanitized execution.
  WHY: Issue-derived diagnostic content runs with ambient `GH_TOKEN`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, and workspace write access.

- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3055), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3087), _git_subprocess_env (lines 2987-2992) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN authentication was changed from command-scoped `http.extraHeader` to embedding the token in HTTPS remote URLs.
  WHY: Tokens become visible in process arguments, Git diagnostics, remote configuration, and subprocess output.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 578-590), memory_force_tick_get (line 767), memory_force_tick_put (lines 883, 919), _memory_force_tick_ensure_branch (lines 624-640) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick operations embed credentials in URLs while other clone, fetch, and push operations use bare Git after `_memory_git` was removed.
  WHY: Credentials leak through argv and diagnostics, while credential-free HTTPS origins fail authentication when `persist-credentials: false`.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: memory_ensure_branch (lines 141, 151, 177, 180) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `memory_ensure_branch` directly runs Git operations without the deleted command-scoped authentication wrapper.
  WHY: The ai-memory branch cannot be read or initialized against credential-free origins and failures are fail-open, silently degrading memory operations.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: Deleted git_with_github_auth (was lines 493-508), deleted review_blocked_* functions (was lines ~980-1410) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The authenticated Git wrapper and review-blocked approval pipeline were removed while live callers remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix and baseline pushes fail, and review-blocked terminal decisions cannot build, verify, consume, or act on approvals.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: _gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest (lines 732-738, 766-772), gh_pr_with_all_comments GraphQL transform (lines 833-847, 913-924) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR comments no longer include `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: The review-blocked approval pipeline cannot authenticate producer comments or authorize approvers even if its helpers are restored.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: Shell usage text lines 7-10 (removed --process-group-file from argument documentation), argument parser lines 49-52 (removed --process-group-file case), review_apply_fixes.sh line 553 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--process-group-file` was removed from the stall guard while `review_apply_fixes.sh` still passes it for isolated editors.
  WHY: The isolated editor launch exits with an unknown-option error before the editor starts and no process-group metadata is written.

- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: Python guard lines 168/195/232-270/302-343 (removed PROCESS_GROUP_FILE env-var, _isolated_user_from_command, _process_identity, child_identity capture, _write_process_group_metadata, _isolated_group_has_members, _child_identity_matches, _verify_isolated_group_stopped, _isolated_group_alive, and privileged signal paths) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-user process-group identity, signaling, survivor detection, and verification were removed.
  WHY: Once option parsing is repaired, isolated descendants can survive cleanup and retain workspace access; severity was reported as MAJOR by one reviewer and BLOCKER by others, so the highest severity is critical.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 121-122 (guard condition checks STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER and STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block depends on `STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER` and `STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR`, but `.github/workflows/implement.yml` does not export them.
  WHY: The restore logic is dead and self-repository implementation can overwrite branch-owned helpers with `SCRIPT_REF` copies.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 152-237 (staged-support rebase block), lines 203-204 (git merge-file invocation) | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `git merge-file` arguments pass HEAD as the base and the staged copy as the other file instead of using the staged copy as the base.
  WHY: When the block runs with divergent branch and staged support files, the merge can drop branch-owned hunks.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py: Lines 30 (import MAX_TARGET_PATHS), 37 (import is_sensitive_target_path), 714, 716, 776, 779, 781 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests import and use `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path`, which were removed from `scripts/targeted_file_context.py`.
  WHY: Pytest collection raises `ImportError` before targeted-file-context tests run.

- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: "Configure git auth for memory helper clones" step (sets GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=http.extraHeader), followed by "Fetch memory helper scripts" step | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Git authentication variables are scoped to one workflow step while later memory operations run in separate shells.
  WHY: Later `git ls-remote`, clone, and push operations use credential-free origins and fail authentication; severity was reported as MAJOR by some reviewers and BLOCKER by others, so the highest severity is critical.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: lines 732-738 (sort_by change), lines 769 (REST jq transform), lines 916-922 (GraphQL jq transform) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Comment sorting replaced the unique comment ID tie-breaker with author and body fields.
  WHY: Identical comments with equal timestamps can be ordered nondeterministically, changing which approval request is selected.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url (lines 578-590) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: File or local-path origins fall through with failure instead of returning a tokenless usable URL.
  WHY: Force-tick operations silently degrade on self-repository runs where authentication is unnecessary.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: line 581 (printf 'https://x-access-token:%s@...') | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An empty GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN produces an invalid URL with empty userinfo.
  WHY: Credential-free memory writes fail with a malformed URL rather than using the prior credential-free fallback.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: emit_context loop body (lines 568-579) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Removing path limits allows one overflowing path to trigger an unbounded series of Semble subprocess calls.
  WHY: Adversarial or large path lists can spend minutes in sequential Semble calls before the editor's first turn.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line: the re-audit checks sibling code paths (other venues, adapters, handlers, workers) for the same defect and re-opens the loop if any remain."
  expected_change_site: All workflows and scripts that contain the same mutable-reference patterns named in the 16 findings.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The PR removed or rewrote broker, process-group, approval-pipeline, URL-authentication, and targeted-context safeguards beyond the cited mutable-reference findings, including scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, and scripts/targeted_file_context.py.

- requirement: "Preserve existing triggers, interfaces, memory behavior, and Telegram no-op behavior when unconfigured."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_helpers.sh, scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh, scripts/write_codex_c
